base.ansatz: u=u0(x)+t*MLP(sin(x),cos(x),t/end)[:3]; p=MLP[...,3]. Exact initial velocity and periodic inputs. No exact transient velocity labels.
base.loss: Mean squared continuity plus sum of three mean squared momentum residuals, equally weighted, no adaptive weighting.
base.scope: Fixed-optimization-budget sampling study. Single paired seed; not asymptotic convergence certification.

interpretation: Time nodes are collocation samples, not time-stepping intervals. Equal optimization budget does not establish that each network is converged.
